content: {"praised":["The 27th Day has an interesting premise and intelligent dialogue","The collection showcases the growth of early sci‑fi genre","The movies pair well together, offering a cohesive theme","The 27th Day is a terrific but underplayed alien ultimatum film","The collection includes rare drive‑in classics with good storylines"],"criticized":["The rest of the movies are dull, slow‑moving, and silly","Many titles are mediocre B‑movie sci‑fi with low quality acting","Some films are one or two star, lacking depth","The overall pacing feels uneven across the set","The humor is often excruciatingly silly and unfunny"]}
